exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Weekends How do you usually spend your weekends? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Weekends Which is your favourite part of the weekend? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Weekends Do you think your weekends are long enough? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Weekends How important do you think it is to have free time at the weekends? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe someone you know who does something well. You should say: who this person is how you know this person what they do well and explain why you think this person is so good at doing this.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Skills and abilities What skills and abilities do people most want to have today? Why?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Skills and abilities Which skills should children learn at school? Are there any skills which they should learn at home? What are they?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Skills and abilities Which skills do you think will be important in the future? Why?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Salaries for skilled people Which kinds of jobs have the highest salaries in your country? Why is this?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Salaries for skilled people Are there any other jobs that you think should have high salaries? Why do you think that?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Salaries for skilled people Some people say it would be better for society if everyone got the same salary. What do you think about that? Why?
